newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic growth slows in 1996 - c. bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic growth slows in 1996 - c. bank.

text.p: Lebanon's 1996 economic growth slowed after three years of sustained growth between 1993 and 1995, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity was 168.3 at the end of December, just a fraction above December 1995's 166.9.
The economy performed unevenly during the year, the bank added.

"Industry, trade, marine transport and construction sectors followed a downward trend while reconstruction work continued on the same pace and financial and tourism services marked sustained growth," it said.

The coincident indicator combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity, but the bank has not revealed the weighting of the different series and some economists question its value.
The bank created the indicator in 1993 because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon which prevents precise calculation of gross domestic product (GDP) and economic growth.
